oracle: Dedicated Playwright-pinned Chromium 153 headless shell. All requests are blocked; the page uses an inline verified Roboto-Regular.ttf FontFace.

font.coverageRule: sameFontOracle is true only when every non-whitespace codepoint is present in the pinned Roboto cmap.

captureNotes.fontFace: Pinned regular Roboto loaded from base64; font kerning is set to normal when supported.
captureNotes.textMetrics: Each case stores width, actual ink bounds, font bounds, em bounds, and hanging/alphabetic/ideographic baselines.
captureNotes.browserApiChecks: Prototype accessors, readonly assignment behavior, illegal new TextMetrics(), and measureText drawing-state preservation are measured from the browser.
captureNotes.unsupportedGlyphs: Cases whose cmap check fails are marked sameFontOracle=false; their metrics may include browser fallback glyphs.
captureNotes.nativeResult: This fixture is a browser reference only; it records no Skia or native Android result.
